name: Carbamide Forte Vitamin D3+K2
ingredients_raw: Vitamin K2 as MK-7 (Menaquinone-7). Vitamin D3 from Lichen (as Cholecalciferol), Stabilizer (INS 1404 & INS 1201), Firming Agent (INS 341 (ii)), Anticaking Agent [INS 460 (i) & INS 551], Thickener (INS 464), Emulsier (INS 466(ii)), Antifoaming Agent (INS 1521) & Preservative (INS 202). CONTAINS PERMITTED FOOD COLOUR (INS 172 (i)).
